name: props_realfluid_water_states
source:
{ Real-fluid water through EVERY input pair and every output the table backend
  serves, at states the shipped table covers. The Java answers these from its OWN
  PhTableRegistry (256/96/48, built at run time) whenever the output is T, Dmass
  or Smass and the inputs are (P, Hmass) -- everything else in here is a direct
  CoolProp call. So this document measures two different things at once and both
  matter. }

{ --- (P, h): the tabulated pair, all three tabulated outputs --- }
t_2ph   = Temperature(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)
d_2ph   = Density(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)
s_2ph   = Entropy(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)
v_2ph   = Volume(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)
u_2ph   = IntEnergy(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)
x_2ph   = Quality(Water, P=101325, h=1500000)

t_vap   = Temperature(Water, P=101325, h=2800000)
d_vap   = Density(Water, P=101325, h=2800000)
s_vap   = Entropy(Water, P=101325, h=2800000)
u_vap   = IntEnergy(Water, P=101325, h=2800000)

t_liq   = Temperature(Water, P=101325, h=200000)
d_liq   = Density(Water, P=101325, h=200000)
s_liq   = Entropy(Water, P=101325, h=200000)
u_liq   = IntEnergy(Water, P=101325, h=200000)

{ --- (P, T): the inverse form, no Java counterpart in the port --- }
h_pt_liq = Enthalpy(Water, P=101325, T=300)
h_pt_l2  = Enthalpy(Water, P=8000000, T=320)
h_pt_vap = Enthalpy(Water, P=101325, T=500)
h_pt_v2  = Enthalpy(Water, P=8000000, T=753.15)
d_pt     = Density(Water, P=101325, T=300)
s_pt     = Entropy(Water, P=101325, T=300)

{ --- (P, s): the second inverse form --- }
h_ps_liq = Enthalpy(Water, P=8000000, s=649)
h_ps_vap = Enthalpy(Water, P=101325, s=7500)
t_ps     = Temperature(Water, P=101325, s=7500)

{ --- (P, x) and (T, x): the saturation lines --- }
hf_p     = Enthalpy(Water, P=10000, x=0)
hg_p     = Enthalpy(Water, P=10000, x=1)
tsat_p   = Temperature(Water, P=10000, x=0)
sf_p     = Entropy(Water, P=10000, x=0)
sg_p     = Entropy(Water, P=10000, x=1)
df_p     = Density(Water, P=10000, x=0)
dg_p     = Density(Water, P=10000, x=1)
h_mid    = Enthalpy(Water, P=10000, x=0.5)
h_x03    = Enthalpy(Water, P=800000, x=0.3)
hf_t     = Enthalpy(Water, T=373.15, x=0)
hg_t     = Enthalpy(Water, T=373.15, x=1)
p_t_x    = Pressure(Water, T=373.15, x=0)
p_t_x1   = Pressure(Water, T=450, x=1)

{ --- the rankine-cycle states D1 calls out by name --- }
h1_rank  = Enthalpy(Water, P=10000, x=0)
t1_rank  = Temperature(Water, P=10000, h=191805.94455889906)
d1_rank  = Density(Water, P=10000, h=191805.94455889906)
s1_rank  = Entropy(Water, P=10000, h=191805.94455889906)
t2_rank  = Temperature(Water, P=8000000, h=199878.01103600737)
d2_rank  = Density(Water, P=8000000, h=199878.01103600737)
s2_rank  = Entropy(Water, P=8000000, h=199878.01103600737)
t3_rank  = Temperature(Water, P=8000000, h=3349645.1659218343)
d3_rank  = Density(Water, P=8000000, h=3349645.1659218343)
s3_rank  = Entropy(Water, P=8000000, h=3349645.1659218343)
t4_rank  = Temperature(Water, P=10000, h=2109393.1272094045)
d4_rank  = Density(Water, P=10000, h=2109393.1272094045)
s4_rank  = Entropy(Water, P=10000, h=2109393.1272094045)
